scripts.clear:all: npx rimraf target allure-results allure-report allure-history screenshots videos build
scripts.clear:results: npx rimraf target/allure-results target/allure-results-chrome target/allure-results-firefox target/allure-results-edge target/allure-results-safari allure-report
scripts.test: npm run clear:results && (npx allure run --config allurerc.json --results-dir target/allure-results -o allure-report -- mvn test || true) && npm run report:open
scripts.test:chrome: npm run clear:results && (npx allure run --config allurerc.json --results-dir target/allure-results -o allure-report -- mvn test -Dbrowser=chrome || true) && npm run report:open
scripts.test:firefox: npm run clear:results && (npx allure run --config allurerc.json --results-dir target/allure-results -o allure-report -- mvn test -Dbrowser=firefox || true) && npm run report:open
scripts.test:edge: npm run clear:results && (npx allure run --config allurerc.json --results-dir target/allure-results -o allure-report -- mvn test -Dbrowser=edge || true) && npm run report:open
scripts.test:safari: npm run clear:results && (npx allure run --config allurerc.json --results-dir target/allure-results -o allure-report -- mvn test -Dbrowser=safari || true) && npm run report:open
scripts.test:headless: npm run clear:results && (npx allure run --config allurerc.json --results-dir target/allure-results -o allure-report -- mvn test -Dheadless=true || true) && npm run report:open
scripts.test:video: npm run clear:results && (npx allure run --config allurerc.json --results-dir target/allure-results -o allure-report -- mvn test -Drecord.video=true || true) && npm run report:open
scripts.merge:results:
mkdir -p target/allure-results && b_list=""; for b in chrome firefox edge safari; do dir="target/allure-results-$b"; if [ -d "$dir" ] && [ "$(ls -A $dir 2>/dev/null)" ]; then cp "$dir"/* target/allure-results/ 2>/dev/null || true; b_list="$b_list $(echo $b | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')"; fi; done; b_clean=$(echo $b_list | xargs | tr ' ' ','); printf "Environment=QA
Project=Automation
Executed.By=Señor
Release.Version=1.0
Browsers.Used=%s
" "$b_clean" > target/allure-results/environment.properties
scripts.test:cross-browser: npm run clear:results && (mvn test -Dbrowser=chrome -Dallure.results.directory=target/allure-results-chrome || true) && (mvn test -Dbrowser=firefox -Dallure.results.directory=target/allure-results-firefox || true) && (mvn test -Dbrowser=safari -Dallure.results.directory=target/allure-results-safari || true) && npm run merge:results && npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
scripts.test:cross-browser:all: npm run clear:results && (mvn test -Dbrowser=chrome -Dallure.results.directory=target/allure-results-chrome || true) && (mvn test -Dbrowser=firefox -Dallure.results.directory=target/allure-results-firefox || true) && (mvn test -Dbrowser=edge -Dallure.results.directory=target/allure-results-edge || true) && (mvn test -Dbrowser=safari -Dallure.results.directory=target/allure-results-safari || true) && npm run merge:results && npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
scripts.test:cross-browser:headless: npm run clear:results && (mvn test -Dbrowser=chrome -Dheadless=true -Dallure.results.directory=target/allure-results-chrome || true) && (mvn test -Dbrowser=firefox -Dheadless=true -Dallure.results.directory=target/allure-results-firefox || true) && (mvn test -Dbrowser=safari -Dallure.results.directory=target/allure-results-safari || true) && npm run merge:results && npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
scripts.test:ci: npm run clear:results && npx allure run --config allurerc.json --results-dir target/allure-results -o allure-report -- mvn test -Dbrowser=chrome -Dheadless=true
scripts.test:ci:chrome: npm run clear:results && npx allure run --config allurerc.json --results-dir target/allure-results -o allure-report -- mvn test -Dbrowser=chrome -Dheadless=true

scripts.test:ci:safari: npm run clear:results && npx allure run --config allurerc.json --results-dir target/allure-results -o allure-report -- mvn test -Dbrowser=safari
